facts.business: PPAP Automotive Limited is an automotive components manufacturer with subsidiaries in batteries, tool engineering, industrial products, and sealing systems.

guidance_or_targets.statement: Merger of Avinya Batteries Limited into PPAP Automotive Limited expected to be completed during FY27
Sale of Tooling Business to Meraki Precision Tool Engineering Limited targeted for completion by Q3FY27

key_risks: Revenue recognition involves significant judgement and estimates in calculation of price variations
Impairment assessment of investments in subsidiaries and joint ventures involves high sensitivity to assumptions and inherent uncertainty
facts.related_party_note: All related party transactions during FY2025-26 were in ordinary course of business and on arm's length basis. No material transactions requiring Form AOC-2 reporting. Details in Note 41 to standalone financial statements.
